title: Yara and the Postcards
author: Gideon Okafor
blurb: Rosalind Dravenmoor, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the house sale closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
